items.resolution: Passed after correction. Ch56 separates pre-execution input-plus-max-token admission from completion-callback accounting of actual tokens and latency. It identifies selective rejection of lower-priority new requests as the evaluated action, labels active termination/KV reclamation as an unvalidated service-class branch, removes unsupported requeue semantics, preserves the single-replica/Qwen3-8B-NVFP4 boundary, and leaves routing/capacity handoff coherent.

Passed after correction. Ch33 now describes the exact-v1 result as a finite-sample variance decomposition that changes MSE, effective prompt count, and rollout cost, without introducing unsupported estimator bias. It retains the U-statistic/Hoeffding mechanism, bounded-reward and smoothness assumptions, fixed-budget trade-off, model/data-dependent constants, limited-run evidence, and no-universal-group-size boundary.

Passed after correction. Ch33 now represents LongRLVR as separately measured answer and context signals combined by r_total = r_ans + r_ctx rather than a binary two-gate admission rule. It identifies the context signal as chunk-label-modulated F-score, explicitly states that alignment to annotated chunks does not prove causal evidence use, and preserves the long-context workload, annotation/provenance, specification-gaming, and open-domain grounding boundaries.
